predecessor_custody.O9_result: SOURCE_ONLY_NO_GO: weak echo retention, parity failure, explicit memory better; both OS and full CI passed

scientific_question: For identically trained public-experience recurrent mechanisms, distinguish state-encoding insufficiency from failure of the learned output readout or nonlinear composition of retained public cue and action parity.

families.ECHO: initial public observation random cue; actions iid binary until single a_t=2 at 14 or 26; intervening next observations iid fair; query response cue XOR independent Bernoulli(0.05); no other predictive targets scored
families.PARITY: same visible public cue and actions; target cue XOR publicly derivable parity of action=1 events before query, flipped with independent Bernoulli(0.05)
families.NULL: same visible query timing and action structure; query target iid fair unrelated to cue/action history

public_source.seeding: Python Random(seed first 8 big-endian bytes SHA256 UTF8 'o10-fresh-public-v1:'+role+':'+family+':'+index)
public_source.data_interface: At t model receives public bit o_t, action a_t and whether t is first; exact same observable history provided to every trained learner. Query next-bit is never an input before prediction, hidden simulator variables never features. Cue and parity probe labels are derived from public history, not private labels. Train on query response only.

frozen_fit.architecture: Byte-identical O9 TrainedMemory implementation Git blob 007f22006211439e625c1c317d32254acf902d74, candidate kind LEARNED_EXTERNAL_WRITE_READ_2, control GRU_2, both 57 trainable weights.
frozen_fit.selection: Select minimum public SELECT query NLL among frozen starts, independent for each arm. Never select on DEV.
frozen_fit.posttrain_probes: Freeze selected checkpoint including recurrent weights and original trained output head. Train separate logistic probes on extracted 2-cell query recurrent state on O10_PUBLIC_TRAIN ONLY for cue, action parity, and query outcome; separately fit a nonlinear quadratic state readout for query outcome. No recurrent update for any probe.
frozen_fit.probe_architecture: Full-batch logistic regression 100 fixed epochs lr 0.5 L2 0.001 zero start, 1 bias plus all features. Quadratic readout features: recurrent h0,h1,h0*h0,h0*h1,h1*h1. No hyperparameter selection.
comparators: CURRENT_QUERY_PROBE: logistic on query current observation and query time flag
PUBLIC_EXPLICIT_EPISODIC_COUNTS: Laplace+1 fitted on (public cue, public action parity) and query bit
PUBLIC_ENGINEERED_LOGISTIC: fit on cue, parity, cue XOR parity, query time and query current observation with identical probe budget
frozen_fit.probe_cue_parity: Train hidden-state cue probe and hidden-state parity probe and matching query-current-only probes using identical budget. Report NLL for each label, all on independent O10_PUBLIC_DEV.
frozen_fit.readout_probe: Report original end-to-end query head, posthoc re-fitted linear hidden-state query head and posthoc quadratic hidden-state query head; compare same frozen representation and TRAIN-only probe supervision.
frozen_fit.ablation: Evaluate original end-to-end model with memory cleared before query, no retraining, and report query NLL delta; retained-state probe evidence alone does not establish transfer.

evaluation.query_loss: mean binary Bernoulli query-only negative log likelihood nats per public episode
evaluation.encoding: If state cue/parity probe improves on matched current-query-only probe on DEV, evidence the frozen state retained that public variable, not proof of general cognition.
evaluation.readout: If TRAIN-fitted readout significantly improves original query NLL on DEV using identical frozen state, a readout-optimization limitation is possible. If no cue/parity information decodes, state encoding insufficiency is plausible. No posthoc tests/claims from unfrozen thresholds.
evaluation.baseline: Compare against fully trained same-input 57-parameter GRU and hand-engineered explicit episodic conventional control, disclose engineered-feature advantage.
evaluation.null: Report all null-family decoded advantages/losses; no false positive claim.
evaluation.cost: per model FIT+SELECT CPU, per probe training CPU, all DEV inference CPU, checkpoint bytes, probe bytes, process CPU, process peak memory, Python tracemalloc peak.
evaluation.repro: all 3 x 3 source-family-role SHA256 identities exact Windows/Linux, all reported losses agree to 1e-6 across systems; final focused tests + one full Go test/vet/build and full public PR regression.
evaluation.decision: Do not promote from public DEV regardless of result. No retrospective changes to protocol, model, source, seed or budget after DEV observation; retain all negative evidence.
